item.title: Bulikula captain praises players' work rate after historic win over France
item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 01/11/2026 Vodafone Fiji Bulikula captain Cassie Staples acknowledges the work rate shown by the players in their 54-6 win against France in the Women's Rugby League World Cup, cementing their place in the semifinals next weekend.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 01/11/2026

Vodafone Fiji Bulikula captain Cassie Staples acknowledges the work rate shown by the players in their 54-6 win against France in the Women's Rugby League World Cup, cementing their place in the semifinals next weekend.

Stapples says when she thinks about the scoreboard, it probably didn't really reflect the intensity of the game.

She gave credit to France, who challenged them in the right areas they need to work on before their semi final clash next Sunday.

The captain says it was a tough game and she proud of results.

The Fiji Bulikula created history by reaching the semi finals in their first Rugby League World Cup appearance.

The Fiji Bulikula will face the Jillaroos at 6.45pm next Sunday in the second semifinals.

New Zealand Kiwi Ferns will meet Samoa at 6.45pm Saturday in the first semifinals.
